title: Conditional κ = 0.00272124 (+3.477e-5 over #4416): retime fresh helper boundaries
body:

Both orientations retain the scalar order and coefficients, main operator, warp contacts and owned center program. The 408 independent productive helpers have profile `{4:26,5:2,7:29,8:42,9:309}`; the complete local paid profile is `{1:2253,2:515,3:445,4:102,5:40,8:8}`.

The unchanged p7 controller still has 7,688 independent productive fields. Its complete paid call count falls **55,998 → 53,133**, saving 2,865 calls (5.12%). Productive/paid rank masses become 133,718/133,110, preserving surplus 608. Exact intervals put the changed-profile root in **(0.0027212601275, 0.0027212601276)**. An interval proof over every real `0<C<1` establishes the fixed-profile ceiling; the declared κ leaves about 2.01e-8 headroom.

PR #4433's fully charged higher-moment tail theorem admits tensor power 150, paid cutoff `10^150`, target floor `15^150`, and sufficient uniform rank **`2^349300000000`**. The unchanged BIT conversion already gives 0.0027418653797 before its final relaxation; admitting it at 0.00273 avoids the obsolete 0.0027 cap. All nine outer cost rows, 54 current predicates and three functional guards pass.
